sn51.14:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati pubbārāme migāramātupāsāde.
sn51.14:1.3: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū heṭṭhāmigāramātupāsāde viharanti, uddhatā unnaḷā capalā mukharā vikiṇṇavācā muṭṭhassatino asampajānā asamāhitā vibbhantacittā pākatindriyā.
sn51.14:2.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ āmantesi:
sn51.14:2.2: “ete te moggallāna, sabrahmacārayo heṭṭhāmigāramātupāsāde viharanti uddhatā unnaḷā capalā mukharā vikiṇṇavācā muṭṭhassatino asampajānā asamāhitā bhantacittā pākatindriyā.
sn51.14:3.1: evaṃ bhanteti kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno bhagavato paṭissutvā tathārūpaṃ iddhābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhāsi. yathā pādaṅguṭṭhakena migāramātupāsādaṃ saṅkampesi sampakampesi. sampacālesi.
sn51.14:3.2: atha kho te bhikkhū saṃviggā lomahaṭṭhajātā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu.
sn51.14:3.3: acchariyaṃ vata bho abbhutaṃ vata bho
sn51.14:3.4: nivātañca vata ayañca migāramātupāsādo gambhīranemo sunikhāto acalo asampakampī, atha ca pana saṅkampito sampakampito sampacālitoti.
sn51.14:4.1: atha kho bhagavā yena te bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā te bhikkhū etadavoca:
sn51.14:4.2: “kinnu tumhe bhikkhave, saṃviggā lomahaṭṭhajātā ekamantaṃ ṭhitāti?
sn51.14:4.4: nivātañca vata, ayañca migāramātupāsādo gambhīranemo sunikhāto acalo asampakampī. atha ca pana saṅkampito sampakampito sampacālitoti.
sn51.14:4.5: tumheva kho bhikkhave, saṃvejetukāmena moggallānena bhikkhunā pādaṅguṭṭhena migāramātupāsādo saṅkampito sampakampito sampacālito.
sn51.14:4.7: katamesaṃ dhammānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā moggallāno bhikkhu evaṃ mahiddhiko evaṃ mahānubhāvoti.
sn51.14:5.2: catunnaṃ kho bhikkhave, iddhipādānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā moggallāno bhikkhu evaṃ mahiddhiko evaṃ mahānubhāvo.
sn51.14:5.4: idha bhikkhave, moggallāno bhikkhu chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti. iti me chando na ca atilīno bhavissati …pe… iti vivaṭena cetasā pariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittaṃ bhāveti.
sn51.14:5.8: iti me vīmaṃsā na ca atilīnā bhavissati. na ca atippaggahitā bhavissati.
sn51.14:5.9: na ca ajjhattaṃ saṃkhittā bhavissati. na ca bahiddhā vikkhittā bhavissati.
sn51.14:5.11: yathā pure tathā pacchā, yathāpacchā tathā pure,
sn51.14:5.12: yathā adho tathā uddhaṃ, yathāuddhaṃ tathā adho,
sn51.14:5.13: yathā divā tathā rattiṃ, yathā rattiṃ tathā divā.
sn51.14:5.14: iti vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittaṃ bhāveti.
sn51.14:5.15: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave, catunnaṃ iddhipādānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā moggallāno bhikkhu evaṃ mahiddhiko evaṃ mahānubhāvo. imesaṃ
sn51.14:5.16: ca pana bhikkhave, catunnaṃ iddhipādānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā moggallāno bhikkhu anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhoti …pe… kāyena vasaṃ vatteti. imesaṃ
sn51.14:5.17: ca pana bhikkhave, catunnaṃ iddhipādānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā moggallāno bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatīti.
